title: Unit dependency map
responsibility: Lets users inspect, search and select units in a dependency diagram or list.

inputs.name: HarnessMap.units
inputs.description: Required units supplying diagram nodes, dependencies and searchable identifiers, kinds and responsibilities.

inputs.name: HarnessMap.marks
inputs.description: Optional map of added, removed, directly changed or indirectly affected units, defaulting to an empty map. Marks add styling and a legend.

inputs.name: HarnessMap.selected
inputs.description: Optional selected unit identifier, defaulting to null. Highlights its neighborhood and controls relevant dependency edges.

inputs.name: HarnessMap.onselect
inputs.description: Required callback invoked when a diagram node or list entry is selected.

outputs.name: HarnessMap
outputs.description: Searchable dependency diagram with pan, pinch, zoom and fit controls, plus a sorted unit list. Search dims unmatched nodes; arrow keys move among nodes and Enter or Space selects. Long displayed identifiers are shortened without changing the identifiers passed to callbacks.
